description: This Java source file defines the class CuttlefishControlRemoteRunner, which implements the CuttlefishControlRunner interface. It provides methods to execute remote commands, retrieve file paths, and access remote files related to Cuttlefish virtual devices, primarily used for testing and automation within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: CuttlefishControlRemoteRunner
classes.description: A class that manages remote control operations for Cuttlefish virtual devices, including executing commands and retrieving files.

methods.name: CuttlefishControlRemoteRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runner with a remote device, determining the base path for runtime files.

methods.name: remoteFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a remote file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a remote command with a specified timeout.

methods.name: getHostBinaryPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to a binary on the host machine.

methods.name: getHostRuntimePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to a runtime file on the host machine.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Fetches a remote file from the device.
